While signed in, interface language follows your verified Argus profile. Otherwise it follows your device. Sample currencies remain labeled.

Finance chat is available to guests within current quotas. Other ecosystem features require an account, even when requested through chat. This local build connects account sessions only; financial actions remain samples.
Temporary chat is not connected in this build. No messages are sent or stored by a chat service. Account sessions and appearance have separate device storage.
Use a currency code, such as DOP or USD. Changing it does not convert money. Currency cannot change after a starting balance is recorded.
Your share of this account. This does not grant access to anyone.
An unknown balance stays unknown until you record it. It is not zero.
For a debt, enter the amount owed as positive. Enter a negative amount only for credit in your favor.

Your changes are still here. Compare them with the latest saved account below before choosing to continue. Nothing will be overwritten automatically. If the currency or asset/debt kind changed, you will need to enter the amount again.
The result is uncertain. Retry the same request to check whether the account was created. Your original details stay fixed so a retry cannot create a duplicate.
Discard these unsaved changes? If a save had an uncertain result, refresh the list to check what reached the server before creating another account.

Use an account name of 60 characters or fewer.
Enter an ownership share from 0.01% to 100%, with at most two decimals.
